entities.name: Query protein uL15
observations: The 144-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q21M39 from Saccharophagus degradans.
Predicted molecular mass is 15.15 kDa and theoretical pI is 10.71; charge at pH 7 is +14.6.
Pfam detects Ribosomal_uL15_N (PF29471.1) at residues 23–58 and Ribosomal_L27A (PF00828.26) at residues 81–143.

entities.name: 23S rRNA binding
observations: Reviewed uL15 annotations state that the protein binds 23S rRNA.
The query has 100% identity and full-length coverage to a reviewed uL15 reference.

entities.name: 50S ribosomal subunit
observations: Reviewed uL15 annotations place the protein in the bacterial 50S large ribosomal subunit.
